purpose: Single-use held-out synthetic qualification population P2prime for FONT-04 candidate; no discovery, calibration or iteration.

generator.permitted_change: Same r2b_generator.py and v1.1 layout: 32 lines per sheet, full final scan bounding-box check and geometry-only precheck before opening. Existing placement, transforms, degradation and damage logic unchanged. Geometry requires final registration; generation additionally requires reviewer acceptance.

seed_derivation.rule: First eight hexadecimal digits of SHA-256 interpreted as an unsigned big-endian integer; existing +17000+i, +31000 and +47000 offsets unchanged.

faces.name: BitstreamCharter-Regular
faces.package_licence: Bitstream Charter permissive licence; notice and trademark acknowledgement required

licensing.rule: Font binaries and generated P2prime pages are never committed; only hashes, manifests and compact metrics.

family_disjointness: IBM Plex Serif, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono, URW Gothic and Bitstream Charter are separate oracle families. These designs are held out from FONT-01 through P2. Charter Type 1 compatibility is subject to the geometry-only precheck.

evaluation_rules.single_use: Evaluate exactly once, with the frozen method and operating point. Any code or parameter change afterwards voids P2prime for qualification and needs a new preregistration.
evaluation_rules.rendering: Both PDFium and Poppler, at native 200/300/600 DPI, original physical coordinates.

pass_criteria.pristine_quality: Per frequent class (>=10 P2 observations), in each renderer: candidate mean and p95 pristine error <= current default.
pass_criteria.material_defects: Blinded review under FONT_04_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md: zero identity-class defects (wrong character appearance, counter opened/closed, missing/added stroke, dot/sliver, weight/slant-class change) in the accepted sample, the rejected sample and the negative-set analogues; candidate total material-defect rate <= current default.
pass_criteria.functional: Text extraction and native search identical to current default; qpdf and OTS pass; deterministic repeat byte-identical.
pass_criteria.economy: Report distinct designs, draws per design, retired/added/net programs, font and PDF bytes. No economy threshold: economy is established on the real financial document (P3), not on P2.

evaluation_rules.no_post_hoc: No target, class, page or renderer may be excluded after P2 results are seen. Abstentions are counted by the frozen method's own rules.
evaluation_rules.criteria_interpretation: P2 criteria below are copied verbatim and apply to candidate vs default; P2 means this P2prime population for these criteria.
evaluation_rules.identity_visibility_rule: Visibility rule (fixed in advance): blinded panels show source | arm at native DPI at 100% and 200%. An identity-class defect counts when the reviewer can distinguish the arm's glyph from the source glyph at either scale; 400% views are informational only. The font-outline xor proxy is reported but is not a pass/fail criterion. The reviewer grades blind and commits all grades before the key is unsealed.

review_package.format: R2a v2 blind review package with separately held sealed key; see qualification/font04/R2A_BLIND_README.md
strata: all admitted substitutions, or random at least 300 stratified by face and DPI if more than 300
review_package.sampling: Specify deterministic seed and allocation before reviewing; include available strata and record shortages explicitly.

conditions: Final non-DRAFT preregistration SHA-256 referenced in method-freeze-ceiling.json
Reviewer acceptance of that exact hash recorded in method-freeze-ceiling.json
single_use_guard.state: Geometry-only requires the final registration hash, matching face and binary hashes, and no OPENED lock; generation additionally requires reviewer acceptance of the final hash and a fresh output. No post-result tuning.

layout: P2 v1.1: each DPI schedule split in order into sheets of 32 lines, baseline 32 + 18*(line % 32) points; full scan bounding boxes must fit 6 x 9 inches.
